compiled_rule.technosphere_information_loss: Only inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off ammonium-sulfate markets receive independent approval. Source is positive one kg compound; complete native regional-storehouse supplier references positive one kg N at documented 21.0% N grade. Factor +0.21 kg native N per signed kg source product preserves the nominal compound-mass supply basis. Use explicit grade 0.21, not 1/4.76 from rounded explanatory mass or an invented solution/concentration multiplier. Preserve signs, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separately listed emissions. Other source versions, patches, system models and reverse routes require independent approval. Source and native CAS are 007783-20-2, ammonium sulfate (NH4)2SO4. Cobalt sulfate is a different compound and is rejected. The RER market also previously used the native N-reference product at factor one, incorrectly treating one kg compound as one kg nitrogen. Correct the candidate identities/factors for both market identities; only exact source3.9 approval is granted. Neither rule has a prior approval, and no existing recipe embeds the rejected cobalt supplier. This is a whole delivered-commodity screening proxy, not reconstruction of the source production portfolio. Source is modelled as pure substance with nominal fertilizer label 21-0-0; native documents 21.0% N. That grade and rounded declared mass are not proof of analytical stoichiometric composition equivalence. No purity, sulfur balance, additional nitrogen or moisture correction is invented. Warnings retain grade/reference-basis and unquantified score differences. The inspected RoW source market combines primary ammonia/sulfuric-acid synthesis and allocated cobalt, nickel and zinc co-products; the European market has its own supply/delivery portfolio. Native complete European inventory uses uncertain caprolactam/nylon by-product energy and allocation assumptions and regional storage/delivery. These technology, feedstock, co-product allocation, heat/feedstock-energy, geography, age, infrastructure, freight and internal-uncertainty differences are explicit. Primary source synthesis is exothermic and states no external heat; do not infer that native complete by-product energy is the same process or balance it away. Replace the source market supply/delivery portfolio by the complete native delivered supply once. Do not append source freight, recover metal, add caprolactam/avoided-product credit, reconstruct source producer shares or add another fertilizer plant. Source/native LCI, LCIA and stochastic equivalence are not claimed. Caller compound mass and supported uncertainty are scaled consistently to native kg N; native internal inventory remains intact.
